one_liner: Pfaff.design is a portfolio built to solve a familiar problem. The work I do sits between UX, engineering, and applied AI, but those layers are hard to show in a traditional format. This site pairs a clear narrative with an embedded agent that lets people explore the reasoning, structure, and technical detail beneath the surface.
projectSummary: Pfaff.design is a portfolio built to solve a familiar problem. The work I do sits between UX, engineering, and applied AI, but those layers are hard to show in a traditional format. This site pairs a clear narrative with an embedded agent that lets people explore the reasoning, structure, and technical detail beneath the surface.

problem.summary: Every portfolio tells a story, but a lot of the real work happens underneath it. The research, the choices, and the systems that hold everything together rarely fit inside a clean set of screenshots. I wanted to build a portfolio that did not hide that part of the work.

goals: Build a portfolio that pairs a clear narrative with an embedded agent
Let people explore the reasoning, structure, and technical detail beneath the surface
Support different kinds of readers (quick overview, details, technical depth)
Keep the experience fast and familiar while revealing deeper structure when needed
responsibilities: Explored fully generative UI, then shifted to a static site with structured system underneath
Created a knowledge base in YAML and JSON for organizing project information
Added intent routing, schemas, and orchestration layer for the agent
Designed schemas, tested prompts, rewrote pathways, and built guardrails
Ensured the system stayed predictable and felt steady and conversational
outcomes: A portfolio that tells a clear story and gives people a way to explore the structure behind it
Static pages that give readers the overview they expect, and an embedded agent for deeper exploration
A system that reflects how I think, how I solve problems, and how I like to work with technology
A place to test ideas about clarity, interaction, and AI-assisted systems
A foundation that leaves room for future versions to become even more adaptive
